scope: Curation-honesty correctness fixes: reclassify_corpus() now restricts candidates to classifier-owned types only (protects rows written by remember_event/remember_relation); evidence_count in consolidate() accumulates across runs instead of being overwritten; classify_content_type() narrows the 'decision' branch by removing the bare \mrejected\M arm (false-positive on operational text); new classifier_owned_types() function as canonical output-domain source of truth. No ranking algorithm change, no confidence/reinforce change, no GUC additions, no schema change.
justification: Functional gate — NO recall-quality claim is made by this release, so no statistical validation is required. All four changes are correctness fixes: (1) reclassify_corpus() data-destructive overwrite of curator-owned content_type values is closed by restricting candidates to NULL or classifier_owned_types(); (2) consolidate() evidence_count accumulation bug is fixed — second-pass cannot double-count because superseded rows are excluded from future scans; (3) classify_content_type() false-positive on 'rejected' removed — genuine rejection decisions still fire via 'decided'/'decision'/'verdict' arms; (4) classifier_owned_types() provides a durable single source of truth for the protection set. No performance-sensitive path was changed. All four fixes have dedicated pg_regress coverage in test_v0142_p2 (extension/ suite) and test_v0142_curation_honesty (root suite). Result parity with 0.14.1 on all pre-existing 50 tests confirmed — 51/51 in extension/ and 7/7 in root suite (updated fixture counts).
schema_change_detail: None — one new function (classifier_owned_types) plus replacements of existing function bodies (reclassify_corpus, consolidate, classify_content_type). No table, column, index or GUC changes.
scoring_impact: none — recall ranking, confidence and reinforce() paths are untouched; no changes to recall_hybrid(), recall_fast(), or any scoring coefficient
recall_ranking_impact: none — no change to result ordering, RRF weights, graph-proximity boost, recency stamping, or any GUC
backward_compat_proof: pg_regress test_v0142_p2 pins all four fixes. All 50 pre-existing extension/ tests continue to pass unchanged. Upgrade path is incremental (0.14.1→0.14.2) or fresh-install. No API surface changes. No GUC additions. reclassify_corpus() signature unchanged (p_dry_run, p_limit). consolidate() signature unchanged.

corpus.note: functional gate only; no recall-quality claim is made by this release and therefore no statistical validation is required
